scientific_path_log.action_taken: Follow the anterior taenia of the cecum to its confluence — the base of the appendix.

scientific_path_log.action_taken: Gently grasp the cecum and deliver the appendix using the taeniae as your guide.

scientific_path_log.title: Divide the mesoappendix
scientific_path_log.action_taken: Ligate the mesoappendix in segments between clamps and divide it down to the appendix wall.

scientific_path_log.action_taken: Crush the appendix at its base with a clamp, then ligate with absorbable suture.

scientific_path_log.title: Confirm mesoappendix hemostasis

scientific_path_log.action_taken: Search for a contained abscess or perforation; if found, evacuate and culture it.
